purpose: Define a future research-only compatibility comparison for measures 1-16 after historical separator-family archaeology reached a preserved evidence gap. This contract must never reinterpret fresh compatibility evidence as recovered historical provenance.

decodedPcmHashConvention.familyHashComparabilityRule: Family A/B classification is allowed only when the fresh capture declares this exact methodId and records the decoded sample rate, frame count and channel count.

freshDigestConventions.installedPackageInventorySha256: SHA256 canonical JSON of installedPackageInventory sorted by normalized package name then version
freshDigestConventions.runtimeFingerprintSha256: SHA256 canonical JSON of runtimeIdentity without runtimeFingerprintSha256 plus installedPackageInventorySha256
freshDigestConventions.modelCacheManifestSha256: SHA256 canonical JSON of modelCacheFiles sorted by path; each row contains path, size and file sha256

comparisonStages.name: capture-completeness
comparisonStages.passCondition: Every required fresh-capture identity field and safety attestation exists; missing runtime/model hashes make the capture incomplete rather than equivalent. Downstream replay fields remain optional until an authenticated historical downstream digest baseline is pinned.

comparisonStages.name: source-and-recipe-lock
comparisonStages.passCondition: Source-audio Git blob, frozen separator recipe and producer source hashes are recorded without changing the historical separator settings.

comparisonStages.name: fresh-runtime-and-model-identity
comparisonStages.passCondition: Package inventory, runtime fingerprint and the complete audio-separator model-cache manifest are internally checksum-consistent. The capture fails closed if the model cache is absent or requested model identifiers are not present.

comparisonStages.name: fresh-stem-identity
comparisonStages.passCondition: Record fresh WAV and decoded-PCM hashes using the pinned Section3 SoundFile int16 convention. Family A/B may be reported only as a current research classification when the methodId is exact and both decoded-PCM hashes match a separately proven research family.

comparisonStages.name: intro-fingerprint-compatibility
comparisonStages.passCondition: Compare fresh measures 1-16 raw-event total, per-stem counts, sweep counts and cache digest against the preserved historical fingerprint. Exact cache digest is strongest; count-only agreement must be labelled weaker compatibility.

comparisonStages.name: classification
comparisonStages.passCondition: Emit one of the allowed classifications below; never emit historical-provenance-closed from fresh execution alone.

allowedClassifications.INCOMPLETE_CAPTURE: Required runtime/model/stem identity evidence is missing.
allowedClassifications.INCOMPATIBLE: One or more source/recipe/runtime/model/intro/safety invariants fail.
allowedClassifications.COUNT_COMPATIBLE_ONLY: Historical intro event counts agree but cache bytes and/or downstream identity are not exact.
allowedClassifications.INTRO_CACHE_EXACT_COMPATIBLE: Fresh intro raw-attack cache digest and fingerprint exactly match the preserved historical cache; this is strong compatibility evidence but not proof of historical separator-family identity.
allowedClassifications.CURRENT_RESEARCH_FAMILY_A_COMPATIBLE: Fresh decoded-PCM hashes match the separately proven current/research Family A pair under the pinned decoded-PCM hash convention.
allowedClassifications.CURRENT_RESEARCH_FAMILY_B_COMPATIBLE: Fresh decoded-PCM hashes match the separately proven current/research Family B pair under the pinned decoded-PCM hash convention. This label must not be shortened to 'historical intro Family B'.

implementationRules: Comparator and producer must be read-only with respect to preserved historical artifacts.
Producer output paths must remain under debug/v143-contextual-prune/ and must never write public/training or analyzer/v143-intro-1-16-evidence/codespace-snapshot.
Comparator and producer must not invoke or grade against a professional reference.
Comparator and producer must not retrain or mutate frozen models/predictions.
Comparator must fail closed when required hashes/runtime/model identity are absent.
Comparator must reject a model capture unless modelPayloadCaptureComplete=true and the package/runtime/model manifest digests recompute exactly.
Comparator must reject Family A/B classification unless decodedPcmHashMethod exactly equals soundfile-int16-always2d-numpy-tobytes-sha256-v1.
Comparator must require freshCompatibilityEvidenceOnly=true and all historical/production/reference/overwrite attestations=false.
Producer must use the same exact stem files for WAV/PCM identity and intro Basic Pitch evidence; it must not separate twice and compare across potentially different L4 families.
Producer must preserve the original 244-row measures 1-16 grid and historical bar phase.
Producer must preserve historical median-onset behavior, four wide-recall sweeps and original band boundaries.
Comparator must emit both evidence strength and explicit excluded claims in every result.
Any future GPU workflow must save its full fresh-capture manifest and raw cache together so provenance cannot be lost again.
nextImplementationStep: Implement a new isolated research-only fresh-capture producer that records the complete manifest and raw cache from one separator pass without writing any historical cache path. Do not execute it until static write-path and provenance guards pass.
